description: React component for taking quizzes, managing quiz loading, answering questions, submitting answers, and displaying results within a learning management system.

methods.name: load()
methods.description: Fetches the list of quizzes from the database and updates the state.

methods.name: checkAssignment
methods.description: Checks for an active assignment for the selected quiz and verifies remaining attempts.

methods.name: loadQuiz
methods.description: Loads a specific quiz along with its questions, handles the timer for timed quizzes, and manages loading state.

methods.name: setAnswer
methods.description: Updates the answers state for a specific question.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all questions have been answered appropriately before submission.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Submits the quiz answers, handles the response, and displays results.

methods.name: renderQuestion
methods.description: Renders individual question UI based on question type (MCQ or TRUE_FALSE).
